blessings.why: Mag +5 or range +1 on the turn the casters reach Dagda: his Res is much lower than his Def.
No durability cost on the Golem turn.

deploy.note: 13 slots: casters with Salamanders for Dagda, Lilian's Longbow Deadeye, Noctula baits the Onager, Simon and Tobias Hammer the Golems. Nydine (stairs stop cavalry) and Nuzzuo sit.

missables.text: Take the Longbow +1 from the Golems: Deadeye from it breaks Dagda's shield (Eshmel appears next turn).

assign.why: Golem drop: Deadeye at range 3–5 triggers Eshmel's shield break

tips.text: Move the army north to the Onager and block the chokes for the humanoid phase
Park Noctula or Loretta at the Onager's farthest range to waste its shots
Pull Golems off their protect tiles before the stairs
Lilian fires Deadeye at Dagda; next turn everyone hits once Eshmel drops the shield
